candidates.change_summary: Replace the recipient transfer with sending funds to msg.sender instead of the provided _recipient.
Replace the transfer with sending half the contract balance to the provided _recipient (using division), leaving remainder in contract.
Replace the require guard so that anyone can call withdrawAll (remove owner-only restriction).
Replace the transfer with a call that forwards gas and returns success; revert on failure to change transfer behavior semantics.
Replace the transfer with zeroing the balance by sending to owner instead of the provided recipient (effectively same for owner but differs when owner != _recipient).
